scope: Raw speech stayed on screen past five minutes in the installed Windows app
mode: Desktop expiry watch (TypeScript unit regression with injected clocks and timers)

evidence_runs.windows_update_0_2_1_to_0_3_2: 39686189128: MSI passed the whole update acceptance (raw expiry 314.6 s and 314.2 s); NSIS kept the raw sentinel visible beyond 365 s in the local journey
evidence_runs.earlier_native_runs: raw expiry observed at 314-315 s in runs 39655092403, 39671111386, 39677713214 (both formats) and 39680510791

root_cause: The desktop purges temporary speech at the earlier of a wall and a monotonic deadline, but Date.now and performance.now drift (wall-clock slew, coarsened performance.now). A timer could fire while both still read live; the purge changed nothing, React kept the same value, and no timer was scheduled again.
repair: watchSpeechExpiry checks before purging and schedules again until the speech is gone (apps/desktop/src/state/privacy.ts); the hook uses it.
known_limitations: 0.3.2 was public 2026-10-21T22:23Z to 22:45Z, then marked prerelease so releases/latest returned to 0.2.1; 0.3.3 carries the repair.
The defect was intermittent (one of eleven native journeys); the installed-update runs on 0.3.3 are its native evidence.
